parse.title: Private Servers
parse.wikitext:
'''Private Servers''' support chat commands.

== Commands ==
* '''/day''' — time-of-day command.
* '''/night''' — time-of-day command.
* '''/allday''' — permanently change the time to day, forever.
* '''/allnight''' — permanently change the time to night, forever.
* '''/lib username''' — allow another player to use your private server's time commands. Added October 26, 2026.
* '''/unlib username''' — revoke another player's permission to use your private server's time commands. Added October 26, 2026.
